paragraphs: As this year comes to a close, I find myself pausing—looking back with gratitude and looking forward with faith. December 31 is more than just the last day of the year; it’s a holy pause between who we were and who God is shaping us to become. Tonight, we say goodbye to the old chapters, not with regret, but with thanksgiving. Every tear, every delay, every quiet battle had a purpose.
2025 may have tested us, stretched us, and humbled us—but it also taught us how to trust God deeper. And now we step into 2026 not empty-handed, but refined. Carrying wisdom, healing, and hope.

The Word says, “For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the Lord, “plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.” (Jeremiah 29:11). And again, “See, I am doing a new thing; now it springs up—do you not perceive it?” (Isaiah 43:19).

To everyone who followed, supported, prayed, and walked alongside this journey—thank you from the heart. May this coming year be filled with God’s peace, clarity, restoration, and unexpected breakthroughs. May what was heavy be lifted, what was broken be healed, and what was delayed arrive in God’s perfect time.
Happy New Year to you and your family. May 2026 be a year of new beginnings, renewed strength, and deeper faith. 🙏✨
